name: Being A Mason
overview: Scripture reveals that true discipleship and salvation are found only through Jesus Christ, who is the way, the truth, and the life, and the light of the world. Believers are called to openly proclaim His name and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit. The Bible warns against being led astray by human traditions and philosophies that do not align with Christ, emphasizing that salvation is found in no other name but His.
